5. Profile-comparison — Compare corporate/shared-IR, typed-library-first, instrument-first and broad sector-first on identical source coverage, joint histories, accounting operations, statements, uncertainty, chronology, review/recovery, extension obligations, authority dependencies and acceptance fixtures. Separate authoring-interface choices from domain scope so alternatives can be combined where appropriate. State tradeoffs, deferred obligations, disqualifying omissions and evidence needed for selection; avoid unsupported effort or superiority rankings. Update the audit, profile fields and open_decisions, including proposed answers, alternatives, consequences and P16 next steps. Stop when all four options receive comparable treatment and every material choice remains explicit.
